To maximize the total reward in a bandit problem, we must balance exploration (trying unknown arms) and exploitation (choosing the arm with the highest observed mean). Since we have only sampled the "Highest Reward" arm once and have two completely unknown arms, it is optimal to explore the other arms to ensure we aren't missing a better distribution.
